Inter (Medium) by Rasmus Andersson, v4.1 - https://github.com/rsms/inter
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see LICENSE.txt).

InterMedium_compressed.inl is a Latin subset (U+0020-007E, U+00A0-00FF and a
few punctuation/arrow glyphs) of Inter-Medium.ttf, made with
  pyftsubset Inter-Medium.ttf --unicodes=... --layout-features=kern --no-hinting
and converted with Dear ImGui's misc/fonts/binary_to_compressed_c (-u8).
Used only by the Debug Tools ImGui menu.
